errors.evidence: This part of the description explains the statistical purpose of a scree plot, which is an interpretation that goes beyond describing the visual elements of the chart itself.
According to the plot, the eigenvalue at factor 3 is approximately 5.7. The value 7.0 corresponds to factor 2.
According to the plot, the eigenvalue at factor 5 is approximately 2.8. The value 5.7 corresponds to factor 3.
According to the plot, the eigenvalue at factor 7 is approximately 1.6. The value 3.0 is incorrect and closer to the value at factor 4 (approx. 3.2).
According to the plot, the eigenvalue at factor 9 is approximately 1.3. The value 2.0 is incorrect and closer to the value at factor 6 (approx. 1.8).
According to the plot, the eigenvalue at factor 11 is approximately 1.2. The reported value of 1.5 is a significant overestimation.
